analogy: Same lead-magnet shape as the e3d-oppscan AI Readiness calculator (idea-17100e68160f, e3d-oppscan) -- a free, instant, deterministic, dropdown-driven score reusing an existing pipeline's published output -- but gated behind email capture instead of a paid-scan CTA, since liquiditywatch has no paid tier to fund yet; this could seed one later.
dedup_rationale: First e3d-pilot ledger entry for e3d-liquiditywatch and first idea proposing an interactive/personalized feature on top of its current passive single-gauge display. Not a duplicate of the existing mailing-list signup -- this adds a new reason to sign up (see your own number) rather than changing the signup mechanism itself. Proposed directly by the repo owner (spacepacket@gmail.com) via conversation on 2026-09-22, explicitly scoped as free/lead-gen rather than a paid feature; not from an automated discover/ideate run.

notes.text:
e3d-debate (grok-build,claude,codex,devin, ran the full 2 rounds without every participant converging) verdict:

FINAL ANSWER: Don't gate the number — show the calculator's score instantly and transparently (this audience treats gating "just arithmetic" as a trust-breaking marketing toll). Convert to email on forward-looking, perishable value instead: pair the instant score with a scenario delta ("68 now, 81 if macro stress escalates one regime") and ask for email specifically to alert on that saved mix. Seed monetization now but keep it the same mechanic, not a bolt-on: free tier is one saved mix with alerts on the site's fixed regime boundaries; the paid seed is letting the user set their own custom threshold on that saved mix — no history, no API, no multi-portfolio tracking until alert engagement validates demand.

CONSENSUS: full
DISSENT: Minor sequencing disagreement only — codex/grok-build want the custom-threshold paid tier explicitly tested/instrumented before building billing, while claude/devin are comfortable committing to it as the paid SKU outright; no disagreement on what the smallest paid version actually is.

Scope refined per e3d-debate verdict (2026-09-22, full consensus) and repo owner's explicit call to stay free-only for now: DROP the original email-gated-number design entirely, and DEFER the debate's proposed paid custom-threshold tier -- monetization is not in scope for this build; the email address itself is the 'price' for now, with the goal being user acquisition and retention, not revenue. Final scope: (1) Ungate everything -- the calculator, the instant 0-100 personal exposure score, and the formula/methodology are all fully public, no email required to see your number. (2) Pair the instant score with a forward-looking scenario delta ('your score is 68 today; it would be 81 if macro stress escalates to the next regime') computed from the same already-published event.final_score and event.asset_triggers[].utility_score data -- this is what makes the score feel perishable/live rather than a one-time toy, per the debate's core insight. (3) The lead-gen/retention hook: let the visitor save their mix and sign up (via the existing POST /api/mailing-list/signup, a distinct list value e.g. 'liquiditywatch-exposure-calculator') for an alert when THEIR saved mix crosses a regime boundary on the next published (material-move-only) update -- this is what holds users past a single visit, since it gives them a concrete reason to want to hear from the site again. (4) Explicitly OUT of scope for this build: any paid tier, custom user-set thresholds, saved-allocation history, or an API -- these were the debate's monetization seed but are deferred; revisit only after alert engagement (opens/clicks/return visits) validates real demand.

summary: Add an interactive 'Personal Liquidity Exposure' calculator to liquiditywatch.e3d.ai: a short dropdown form (rough portfolio mix -- % equities/cash-like, % BTC, % ETH, % XRP, and a leverage/margin toggle) that combines the visitor's inputs with data the site already fetches from the live financial-stress-monitor API (event.final_score, and event.asset_triggers[].utility_score for BTC/ETH/XRP per docs/API-CONTRACT.md) into a deterministic 0-100 personal exposure score plus a one-line explanation banded to the same six regimes the main gauge already uses (Accommodative through Market Dysfunction). Unlike the oppscan readiness calculator, there is no existing scoring function to reuse here -- the portfolio-combination formula is new, deterministic arithmetic (e.g. weighting each crypto allocation by its inverse utility_score as a 'fragile plumbing today' proxy, scaled by the current macro final_score), computed client- or server-side with zero new LLM calls, since the upstream three-stage AI pipeline already did the expensive work and this only consumes its published numbers. Purpose is explicitly lead-gen, not monetization: this product has no paid tier today (its only existing conversion mechanic is the mailing-list signup at POST /api/mailing-list/signup), so gate the personalized numeric result behind that same signup flow (a distinct `list` value, e.g. 'liquiditywatch-exposure-calculator', so this funnel's signups are attributable) rather than a payment -- the calculator itself and the explanation of what it means should stay visible to everyone, only the visitor's own computed score requires an email to reveal, consistent with 'lead-gen, keep it free.' Should reuse the existing SSR caching pattern in server.js (event fetched/cached, not re-fetched per calculator submission) and the existing render.js helper conventions rather than introducing a second data-fetching path.
title: Personal Liquidity Exposure calculator, gated behind mailing-list signup (lead-gen, no payment)
